parameters.query:
INSERT INTO kobllux_interactions (event_id, occurred_at, source, archetypes, tags, payload)
SELECT event_id, occurred_at, source,
       ARRAY(SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text(archetypes)),
       ARRAY(SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text(tags)), payload
FROM jsonb_to_record($1::jsonb) AS event(
    event_id UUID, occurred_at TIMESTAMPTZ, source TEXT,
    archetypes JSONB, tags JSONB, payload JSONB
)
ON CONFLICT (event_id) DO NOTHING
RETURNING event_id;
